    Modules over directed algebras #

    Bricks are indecomposable (isIndecMod_of_brick). The projective P(x) = A e_x of a live point is a nonzero brick (DirData.projIndNT). The support of a module is the set of points y with e_y M ≠ 0 (DirData.Supp).
